_comment: Aggregate plate-recognition-rate (%) per dataset, recomputed from results/provenance/per_run_metrics.tsv as mean +/- sample (n-1) std. Each matches the paper to the reported precision. Source = original training notebooks (per-seed) in the COLAB working set; this repo does not re-train them (gated data).

CCPD.metric_note: Hard-all incl. Weather (sample-weighted union of the 7 test-split hard subsets, matching the baseline aggregate protocol); runs derived from ccpd_per_subset.tsv (6-subset test split folded with the Weather subset). The 6-subset value excl. the near-saturated Weather subset is 93.12 +/- 0.23.

LPLC.metric_note: 5-fold CV x 2 iterations; per-fold + per-legibility in lplc_per_fold.tsv

zeroshot._comment: RodoSol->LPLC cross-domain. Each row is ONE RodoSol checkpoint (notebook 'lan 1') evaluated on the 10 LPLC fold test sets; the 5x2 labeling reuses each of 5 distinct partitions twice, so std is cross-partition variance of a single model, not seed variance. Per-fold rows in zeroshot_per_fold.tsv.

RodoSol2LPLC_zeroshot_12k.std_note: notebook prints 0.31 from full-precision inputs; recompute from 2-dp rows gives 0.32
